answer.answer: The July 2016 posts mention Hillary Clinton mostly in critical or campaign-related ways. Several posts attacked her character or fitness for office: one called her "a liar and we have evidence" tied to the #DNCleak [T4-002868](#T4-002868), another said "#CrookedHillary is so fake she can say everything to attract voters!" with #NeverHillary hashtags [T4-002659](#T4-002659), and one compared voting for her to "trying to put out the fire with gasoline" under #Trump2016 [T4-002843](#T4-002843). A post urged readers not to forget #HillaryForPrison [T4-002670](#T4-002670), and another reported that "Ryan says Congress examining possible action on Clinton's email use" [T4-002691](#T4-002691), while a separate post noted Donald Trump mentioned "Hilary's emails" but not police killings of Black people [T4-002725](#T4-002725). Policy criticism appeared in a post claiming "Hillary Clinton admires Germany's immigration model" [T4-002861](#T4-002861) and an editorial headline about "Hillary Clinton's Anti-Israel, Pro-Hezbollah Donor" [T4-002913](#T4-002913). Supportive or neutral mentions included a post about "Another moment of excitement from Bill during Hillary's speech" with #ImWithHer [T4-002918](#T4-002918), a jab at "Hillary supporters who want 4 more years of Obama" [T4-002799](#T4-002799), a joke that "Hillary thinks her invention is Hillarious" [T4-002870](#T4-002870), and a post questioning what voters who disagree with both Trump and Hillary can do [T4-002758](#T4-002758). Related family mentions included "Chelsea Clinton's father is" [T4-002808](#T4-002808) and a #BillClinton post [T4-002899](#T4-002899).

question: {"query": "What do RightTroll accounts say about immigration?"}

answer.answer:
The retrieved RightTroll-scoped posts touch immigration in a few ways:

- A distinction between legal and illegal migration: one post claims the USA allows 1 million legal immigrants each year, "more than any other nation," and insists "Illegals are NOT immigrants" [T4-009519](#T4-009519).
- Border/enforcement framing: a post frames "irony" in Democrats refusing to fund a Border Wall "to keep Illegals Out" while expecting the public to fund sanctuary cities "to Keep them In," tagging @realDonaldTrump and @seanhannity [T4-008836](#T4-008836). Another calls for putting "every vet back to work by shoot first to kill at our border" [T4-009141](#T4-009141).
- Anti-Muslim/anti-asylum framing abroad: a post alleges Justin Trudeau "has been deliberately erasing any intel on illegal alien Muslim migrants" in Canada, sourced via @barenakedislam [T4-009075](#T4-009075).
- DACA: one post sarcastically urges @realDonaldTrump to "Have a heart. Deport the whole DACA family," using #HeWillNotDivideUs [T4-008898](#T4-008898).
- Immigration linked to voting claims: a post supports voter purges because "illegals and dead people are not supposed to vote" [T4-008530](#T4-008530).

Several other posts in the set are link-only or unrelated hashtags (e.g. #IndependenceDay, #BLM, #gender) and add no immigration content [T4-008368](#T4-008368) [T4-008528](#T4-008528). Note this is bounded retrieval, not a representative sample, and claims above are as stated in the posts, not verified.

question: {"query": "What did RightTroll accounts say about immigration in November 2016?"}
